spec_match.rationale: Builds the motivating product pattern the chromestatus motivation describes — one accent-color declaration theming native controls and custom UI via AccentColor/AccentColorText — plus color-mix() derivation, which the WPT explicitly requires to resolve.

interactive.rationale: Hue slider and lightness select write exactly one property (accent-color) on the card; Save button and live readout re-resolve the themed surfaces.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises one-declaration theming plus a color-mix derived palette; both are on the page.

edge_cases.rationale: Handles unparsed/static/follows tiers and guards the color-mix(AccentColor) composition behind its own CSS.supports check, but intentionally leaves deep edge cases (cycles, forced-colors) to the contrast-and-cycles page.

references.rationale: Links the chromestatus entry and MDN color-mix alongside sibling concepts.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite covers the mirroring and contrast contracts this page's theme relies on; the derived-palette composition is additionally guarded in-page by CSS.supports.

runtime_evidence.rationale: CDP-driven on Chromium 141: hue slider input (debounced readout), lightness change, and Save all verified; native controls visibly tracked the oklch accent in screenshots while custom pieces stayed in labelled fallback; console clean; both viewports screenshot-verified. The themed (follows) tier and the AccentColorText flip need Chrome 158.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts the probe tier with mixWorks detail, the button-tracks-accent contract on the follows tier, and the Save interaction.

design_system.rationale: All fallback and static pairs use design-system variables (button fallback is text-black/bg-ivory per the button rule); dynamic AccentColor/AccentColorText pairing is the UA's own contrast guarantee and is noted as such.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled slider with output element (aria-describedby), native select, native form controls with labels, 44px targets, single polite readout that is debounced against slider spam.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No horizontal overflow at 360×740 DPR3; card and controls stack cleanly; both classes screenshot-verified including the tinted native controls.

openQuestions.title: Verify the full themed card on real Chrome 158+/Canary
openQuestions.detail: On Chrome 158 the primary button, badge, header tint and four palette swatches should all derive from the one accent-color write, and flipping lightness to dark should flip AccentColorText to white. None of that can run on this container's Chromium 141; verify visually and record the readout verdict lines.

openQuestions.title: Add a canvas fillStyle composition demo
openQuestions.detail: The WPT resolution test also requires AccentColor to resolve as a canvas 2D fillStyle. A small additive concept could draw chart bars in AccentColor so canvas UIs stay theme-consistent too — a distinct composition surface not covered by the current portfolio.

openQuestions.title: Inspect the accessibility tree with chrome-devtools-mcp
openQuestions.detail: chrome-devtools-mcp was unavailable; the output element binding and debounced live region were verified by CDP evaluation only, not against the accessibility tree per project rule 7b.

guidanceConsulted.query: one design token driving a whole component theme reactively
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Have descendant components react to a single higher-order token change rather than per-component style writes.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: accent-color is that token: the page's only dynamic write is card.style.accentColor; every themed surface (native controls, AccentColor button/badge, color-mix tints) reacts in pure CSS.

guidanceConsulted.query: announce dynamic status readout updates to screen readers live region
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Debounce frequently-changing live regions so slider drags don't spam screen readers; keep one polite region.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Slider input debounces the role=status readout by 250ms; discrete changes (select, Save) announce immediately.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: applyTheme()'s debounce path; CDP slider set + 400ms wait showed a single coherent readout.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive settings card layout without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use wrapping rows and intrinsic max sizes so cards fit narrow viewports.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Card rows flex-wrap, ranges/progress carry max-inline-size: 100%, card max-inline-size 34rem.

summary: Product-case page verified on Chromium 141 headless: one-property writes drive the native controls (visibly tinted in screenshots) while custom surfaces stay in labelled fallback with an honest banner; slider/select/save interactions and debounced announcements verified via CDP; console clean; both viewports pass. Themed tier and color-mix palette need a Chrome 158 run.
